reports.title: BURLINGTON STORES REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 EARNINGS

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For Fiscal Year 2026 (the 52-weeks ending January 30, 2027), the Company now expects:

desk.headline: Revenue up 8.4% to $2.94bn, below estimates; adjusted EPS of $1.73 in line; comps +1%; Q4 EPS outlook cut by $0.20
results: Total revenue rose 8.4% to $2.94bn, short of the $2.98bn estimate; comparable store sales rose only 1% after a warm October cut store traffic.
Adjusted EPS of $1.73 was roughly in line with the $1.72 estimate and above the company's own guidance, but below $1.80 a year ago.
Gross margin slipped to 43.7% as freight costs rose; tariff refunds were put back into lower prices.
Inventory was up 16%, driven by 119 net new stores and a 10% rise in inventory per comparable store.
Burlington bought back $81m of shares in the quarter and the board approved a further $750m through February 2029.

guidance.summary: Burlington cut its Q4 adjusted EPS outlook by $0.20 to $4.85–4.95 for higher fuel and freight costs, while keeping its Q4 comparable sales guide of +1% to +3%. Full-year adjusted EPS is now $11.70–11.80, up 15–16% on last year.

points: Management estimated warm weather took about 3 points off Q3 comps; weak traffic, not smaller baskets, was the issue.
Early November stayed soft, picking up on colder days, but management said November says little about the holiday quarter.
Higher diesel costs trimmed about half a point from Q3 gross margin, with about $17m of extra freight cost expected in Q4.
The $55m of tariff refunds received in Q2 is being spent on lower prices, about 40% in Q3 and the rest in Q4.
An early FY27 plan assumes comps of 0–2% and sales growth of 5–7%, which management described as deliberately cautious.
call.source: Call transcript: Investing.com, 24 Nov 2026; Trend & Ticker, 24 Nov 2026

watch: Holiday comps against the +1% to +3% guide, and the risk of another warm winter.
Fuel and freight costs, including contract resets in spring 2027.
Whether higher inventory clears without extra markdowns.
